goal: Establish original Call/contextual-effects source/native correspondence and advance the independently justified implementation path.

original_claims.quantifiers: For the original `my receive (f: () -> 'a) = { my g = f(); g() }`, every original xi=(nu,K,D), and every original complete first-Call return witness z, preserve same provider, captures, scope/binders, whole Unit carrier, entry/current configuration, pending Bind/future obligations, and both tagged images. accepted_meaning.rule: Keep the original joint Call/contextual-effect relation, source domain, complete and pending observations, actual provider, effect ownership/lineage and quantifiers. Tests or scalar constraints alone do not close a proof gate.

original_obligations: F1 finite Image/frame action in its original scope
FK1 opaque foreign-continuation quantifier (distinct from F1)
FIRST-RESULT-ADEQUACY in its original source/native scope
original_status: OPEN: all three original parent obligations remain open; no result in this sprint candidate changes them until primary adjudication and independent review.
non_goals: No new language semantics or narrower source domain
No production inference change depending on an open A/B premise
No theorem promotion from tests or conditional notes
No runtime/source restriction, annotation change, or altered observable effect meaning

stages: Pin original statements, source constructors and previously rejected constructions.
Construct the required finite Image/frame actions; preserve FK1 as a distinct case.
Check source/native obligations and adversarial counterexamples with exact shared premises.
Apply each established result to the parent and produce a coherent conclusion or precise reduced premise.
proof.review: Fresh isolated compiler_referee, not Astra author or Sol contributor.

stages: Identify the largest safe source-to-execution slice under already approved semantics.
Trace and complete its actual constraint-generation/propagation/consumer path.
Run focused end-to-end verification for the established contract.
Freeze a substantial reviewed milestone; keep dependent unproved production cutover OPEN.
owner_route: crates/yu-solver/src/shadow_apply.rs: constraint generation, propagation and consumer dispatch
crates/yu-solver/src/candidate_effect.rs and candidate_context.rs: contextual effect construction and lineage
implementation.acceptance: Trace one approved source Call with contextual effects through source owner, generated constraints, propagation and Call/effect consumer; add or preserve focused native and public runtime evidence. Do not claim full source coverage, theorem closure, semantic soundness, or production cutover from tests.
implementation.fallback: Owner-specific NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE after bounded inspection of at least two relevant approved owners; no provisional prototype unless its exact falsifier and rollback owner are recorded.

success_evidence: An original proof conclusion/refutation or a strictly reduced, precisely owned premise applied to F1, FK1, or FIRST-RESULT-ADEQUACY while all other quantifiers remain explicit.
An independently reviewed source/native correspondence slice naming source constructor, constraint generation, propagation, consumer and actual execution evidence.
A reviewed end-to-end compiler improvement under the accepted semantics, with focused checks and all original theorem/cutover limitations recorded.
